text:
elaine_marketing: quick one — launching the webinar next week. need a tight SEO + redirect handoff so the landing, replay post, and benchmark blog don't cannibalize. can we get a checklist today? cc @devin_seo @leah_content @emily_analytics

devin_seo: on it. main asks: keyword targeting matrix, JSON-LD for Event + FAQ + VideoObject (if we host replay), canonical strategy, and explicit redirect table for legacy URLs. i'll add a crawl-priority note for /webinars.

leah_content: i'll map H1/H2s to keyword intents and add suggested meta descriptions for the landing and the follow-up evergreen post. also will propose internal linking anchors to the pricing and demo pages.

miguel_growth: from growth: ensure utm params for registration links and replay CTAs. proposed: utm_source=webinar, utm_medium=email, utm_campaign=serve_llm_launch_v1. also we want to funnel signups to /demo?flow=webinar after replay.

emily_analytics: for analytics, add GA4 event names: webinar_register, webinar_watch_replay, webinar_demo_click. we should push dataLayer pushes on CTA clicks. i'll share GTM snippet.

devin_seo: sample JSON-LD i'll paste into the sheet. Note: use VideoObject if replay is on our domain; if hosted elsewhere mark embedUrl. Also include mainEntity as FAQPage to surface Q&As. Example (short):
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Serving LLMs: Practical Patterns","startDate":"2026-06-02T18:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.inference/webinars/serving-llms"}}
```

devin_seo: canonical policy: landing -> /webinars/serving-llms ; replay blog -> /blog/serving-llms-replay (canonical to that). noindex query params. add rel=\"next\"/rel=\"prev\" only if we paginate archive pages.

leah_content: found three old tags and two legacy posts that overlap. i'll mark which should 301 to the new blog vs which to merge. suggested redirects (in sheet):
```
/source/old-serve-llms,/webinars/serving-llms,301,legacy event page
/blog/2023-llm-costs,/blog/serving-llms-benchmarks,301,merge content
```

miguel_growth: for partner links we need rewrite rules that preserve utm and map vanity paths. example nginx: `return 301 https://redwood.inference/webinars/serving-llms?$args;` or use map to append specific utm. we'll coordinate with eng.

sam_product: eng preference is to push a CSV to CDN-edge redirects (columns: source,target,code,comment). send final CSV and we'll ingest. for any query-string preservation, add a flag column.

devin_seo: QA checklist for when pushed: 1) run Search Console URL inspection for landing and replay 2) test structured data with Rich Results Test 3) mobile-friendly test 4) crawling check for redirect chain length (max 1 hop) 5) verify HTTP status codes and cache TTLs 6) run internal link crawler to ensure anchors are present and no orphan pages.

emily_analytics: also verify UTM mapping in HubSpot and that the demo flow attribution works — send sample registration then confirm session attribution.

elaine_marketing: timeline: keywords & JSON-LD by EOD today, redirect CSV tomorrow morning, eng ingestion Tuesday. leah, can you confirm keywords include both intent head and longtail variations (e.g., "llm serving cost reduction" vs "how to serve large language models cheaply")?

leah_content: confirmed. i'll include head terms + 6 longtails per page and recommended internal anchor phrasing.

devin_seo: one more: sitemap update — ensure /webinars/ and /blog/ pages are in sitemap.xml with correct lastmod dates and priority. ping webmaster once CSV is live to re-submit sitemap to Search Console.

seo-crawl-bot: scheduled run at 1834601700 detected 2 broken links in staging (will DM list). recommended: fix relative image paths and ensure og:image canonicalization.

elaine_marketing: amazing. i'll consolidate the sheet and tag eng + analytics. thanks team :rocket:
